title: Product Manager – AI Assistant
description:
Product Manager – AI Assistant

Manchester | Hybrid, minimum two days per week in the office | £60,000–£80,000 depending on experience

We’re recruiting for a Product Manager to own the roadmap for an AI assistant within an established consumer app. You’ll work with engineers, designers and data specialists to launch features that help customers find answers, make informed decisions and take action while staying in control.



What you’ll do

  • Own the product roadmap and use customer research, analytics and business priorities to decide what to build next.
  • Work with your squad to launch and improve features, including how customers discover and use the assistant in the app.
  • Define how you test and measure AI quality, including whether answers are accurate, clear and relevant to each customer.
  • Work with Compliance, Risk and Legal to deliver a safe and fair experience, including for customers in vulnerable circumstances.
  • Use experiments and customer feedback to measure whether the assistant helps people achieve what they set out to do.
  • Work with internal teams and external partners to introduce new capabilities, communicate trade-offs and contribute to quarterly planning.


What you’ll bring

  • Around three years or more in product management for consumer mobile or web products.
  • Experience taking a product or feature from idea to launch, including shipping AI-powered features to real users.
  • A practical understanding of how large language models (LLMs) work, where they fall short and how to use tools such as Claude.
  • A track record of improving customer outcomes through experimentation, analytics and user research.
  • Confidence working with technical and non-technical teams, explaining complex ideas clearly and making decisions when requirements are still taking shape.

Experience with AI evaluations, AI agents that take actions on behalf of users, third-party data integrations or products that help customers build new habits would be useful.

Interested? Apply with your CV. If you can, include a brief example of an AI feature you helped launch and how you measured its impact.
